scope: Independent read-only PRINT2 measurement inspector audit

checks.domainParser: UI directly imports importPrintedMeasurementDataset; no alternate normalization.
checks.main: Mounted after material details; no project/case/solver API imported by widget.
checks.calibration: synthetic and reported measured provenance are separate; calibration reports explicitly unverified; normalized accuracyVerified=false.
checks.safeText: Metadata uses textContent and fixed SVG attributes; no HTML insertion.
checks.lifecycle: Generation rejects ABA/replacement/pending disposal. Input invalidation clears output and revokes owned URLs; bfcache persisted invalidates without destroying entry.
checks.capacity: Combined exact 2000000 UTF-8 bytes, 100 specimens, 10000 aggregate samples accepted. 100 selector entries; 50 visible table rows; chart <=201 points; all samples/raw bytes/hash preserved.
checks.downloadFailure: Second URL failure revokes first owned URL and keeps validated inspection usable.

performance.limitation: Single Windows Node fake-DOM observation; not a browser rendering budget or real-device performance guarantee.

limitations: Real browser 390px and bfcache HTTP navigation validation are handled separately by root.
No measured material calibration, fitting, solver application or accuracy claim.
summaryJa: 測定読取UIを独立監査。容量・非同期破棄・一部URL生成失敗・復帰時の再検査を追加検証し、必須修正は見つからなかった。
summaryEn: Independent measurement-inspector audit adds combined-capacity, asynchronous disposal, partial URL failure and restored-entry checks; no mandatory fix identified.
